root_cause_analysis.summary: Retry/backoff mechanism correctly implemented at code level (154/154 tests pass, 12/12 mock integration chunks retry correctly) but does not execute retries in live ProviderManager path against NVIDIA API.
what_works: ProviderManager.complete() → execution_policy.execute() retry loop executes correctly in mocks
RetryPolicy(max_attempts=3, base_delay_seconds=5.0) produces 3 attempts with 5s/10s/20s delays
Configuration verified at every layer: config, CLI defaults, speed policy, metadata propagation, ProviderManager creation, 429 classification
what_fails: Zero retries executed in live runs — each chunk makes exactly 1 provider call
Immediate 429 failure — no 5s/10s/20s backoff delays observed
All chunks fail when explicit retry params provided
root_cause_analysis.unexplained_discrepancy: The exact same code path that executes 3 retries in mock tests executes zero retries against the real NVIDIA API. Live progress logs show only 1 second between 'prepare' and 'engine error' — no 5s+ backoff delay.

completeness_gate.behavior: Partial translations (2/4, 3/4 chunks) now correctly report 'status': 'incomplete' instead of 'success'

outstanding_blockers: ProviderManager retry not executing in live path — Despite correct configuration (verified at every layer), the execution_policy.execute() retry loop does not run against the real NVIDIA API. All mock/integration tests pass (12/12 chunks retry correctly).
NVIDIA API rate limit — Strict limit prevents 4-chunk completion without proper backoff.
next_steps_required: Debug ProviderManager retry execution in live path — Add instrumentation to verify execution_policy.execute() retry loop runs against real NVIDIA API
Verify retry timing — Confirm 5s/10s/20s delays in live execution
Achieve 4/4 chunks complete — With retries executing, full regression should succeed
Quality gate PASS — Verify Quality v5 score on complete translation

final_judgment.reason: The retry/backoff mechanism is correctly implemented at the code level (154/154 tests pass, 12/12 mock integration chunks retry correctly) but does not execute retries in the live ProviderManager path against the NVIDIA API. The regression completes 0/4 or 2/4 chunks with HTTP 429 errors, and no retry delays are observed. The NVIDIA API rate limit is the fundamental constraint. Without executing retries with proper backoff, full 4-chunk coverage cannot be achieved. This blocks RM6 Promotion until the live execution discrepancy is resolved.
